cells.gaps: The AGER director general's 23 per cent and the World Bank's 29.4 per cent for 2024 differ from the round table's figure; whether the 25.7 per cent counts people or households is not stated.
cells.note: The latest figure, 25.7 per cent of rural people cited at the November 2025 national plan round table, is below the 27 per cent line, so stage 1. Under message 138 a figure from any source counts, not only the World Bank series.
